tweaks.title: Remove menu open delay
tweaks.description: Windows waits about 400 ms before drawing a menu. Setting the delay to zero makes the shell feel immediate.

tweaks.title: Disable pointer acceleration
tweaks.description: Makes cursor movement proportional to physical movement. Better for aiming in FPS games; some people dislike it on the desktop.

tweaks.title: Disable Game DVR recording
tweaks.description: Stops the Xbox Game Bar from capturing gameplay in the background and may reduce frame-time spikes.

tweaks.title: Disable network throttling
tweaks.description: Removes the rate limit Windows applies to multimedia streams. Can reduce latency spikes in online games.
tweaks.warning: Affects all multimedia traffic on this machine, not only games.

tweaks.title: Lower multimedia CPU reservation
tweaks.description: Reduces the CPU share Windows reserves for background multimedia tasks, leaving more for the game under load.
tweaks.warning: May make background audio or video stutter on low-core machines.
